# fly_redis (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org` (String) Organization slug
- `plan` (String) Plan name. Use `fly redis plans` to list available plans.
- `primary_region` (String) Primary region, can't be changed later

### Optional

- `eviction` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) The name of your Redis database. Leave blank to generate one.
- `read_regions` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `private_ip` (String)
- `public_url` (String, Sensitive)
